name: agent-qa
shortDescription: Natural-language web and mobile QA from vostride, with a memory engine, self-improvement, and evidence from test runs.
description: agent-qa is a natural-language QA tool from vostride for testing web, Android, and iOS user journeys. It provides a CLI, a locally served web dashboard, and local stdio MCP integration with coding agents. Its memory engine reuses test knowledge across runs, while self-improvement validates lessons and retires stale knowledge. This is an early release requiring Node.js 24+. The web platform label refers to its dashboard and browser-testing workflow, not a hosted SaaS account.

pricing.details: Software use is free for purposes permitted by FSL-1.1-ALv2. Competing commercial use is restricted. Model-provider usage and device infrastructure costs are separate.

features: Natural-language QA for web, Android, and iOS user journeys
Persistent memory and self-improvement from validated test lessons
CLI, local web dashboard, and local stdio MCP integration
Retained test evidence for reviewing results
useCases: Checking a user journey after an application change
Investigating a UI regression with recorded test evidence
limitations: Requires Node.js 24+ and a configured model provider; mobile testing requires suitable device infrastructure.
FSL-1.1-ALv2 restricts competing commercial use and does not qualify for this directory’s OSI-approved license flag.
The public website is not a remote MCP endpoint.
